notes: v662 - the Climbers reason is short again. The last few versions made it accurate and far too long: three lines of prose crammed into a narrow gold column, which in a list is as good as useless. It now gives a verdict you can read at a glance - 'proven, but too small to trade', 'proven, but loses money', 'needs ~19 more fires', 'strength 1.4 of 2.0 needed' - and the full explanation, including the dollar figure on your own position size and how the spread compares with the flat $6 brokerage, moved to the hover tooltip where it belongs. Nothing was lost, it is just no longer shouted at you. Display only; no scores or rules changed. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
